quote: To prevent queries from blocking the UI, Room doesn't support database access on the main thread.
note: 頁面講主執行緒禁查詢、DAO 要非同步(suspend/Flow);頁面未直接提 allowMainThreadQueries 這個名字,但核心主張一致。「沒開時丟 IllegalStateException」頁面未逐字講。

quote: Room requires the `suspend` keyword to make your one-shot DAO queries asynchronous with
note: 標準寫法(suspend 或 Flow)頁面表格與文字都有;後果『擋住或丟例外』只在『不支援主執行緒存取』間接支持。

quote: Never create more than one instance of `DataStore` for a given file in the same process.
note: 同頁後文講多實例會丟 IllegalStateException,並教檔案頂層 preferencesDataStore 委派以維持單例。

quote: After calling `edit()` on a `SharedPreference`, you must call `commit()` or `apply()` on the editor to save the results.
note: lint 規則說明原文;SharedPreferences 官方 javadoc 也寫 you must call commit() to have any changes show up。

quote: Whereas `commit` blocks and writes its data to persistent storage immediately, `apply` will handle it in the background.
note: 後果(同步寫磁碟卡主執行緒)與 javadoc 的 UI Thread Blocking 一節一致。

quote: Note that you *must not* modify the set instance returned by this call. The consistency of the stored data is not guaranteed if you do
note: javadoc getStringSet 原文;後果『改動不會保存』對應 consistency not guaranteed,略弱但方向一致。

quote: The Android team strongly recommends against using `SharedPreferences` for new data storage needs.
note: 同頁列出 UI 執行緒阻塞與 ANR(pending apply 會擋主執行緒)、資料毀損等缺點;並建議小資料用 DataStore、關聯式與大資料用 Room。

quote: The generic type of the `DataStore<T>` must be immutable.
note: 同段:Mutating a type used in DataStore invalidates the consistency that DataStore provides。

quote: Do not mix usages of `SingleProcessDataStore` and `MultiProcessDataStore` for the same file.
note: 同段說跨程序必須用 MultiProcessDataStore。『資料損毀或覆蓋』後果頁面未逐字寫。

quote: By default, DataStore doesn't automatically recover from corruption, and attempts to read from it will cause the system to throw a
note: 原文接 CorruptionException;同頁範例 readFrom 內 catch SerializationException 後 throw CorruptionException,並教 ReplaceFileCorruptionHandler。

quote: All operations are serialized, and the transform itself is a coroutine so it can perform heavy work such as RPCs.
note: 官方 updateData 文件明說 transform 是 coroutine、可以做 RPC 這類重工作,與型錄『transform 只放純計算、不可 I/O』的標準寫法相反。型錄本列也標『出處不全』。至多可保留成效能/重試取捨的建議,但不能說官方禁止;『重試時副作用重複』頁面未提。

quote: Columns defined as STRING are actually numeric.
note: 說明另有:numeric-looking strings 會丟前導零,建議改用 TEXT。

quote: You should be using `enqueueUniquePeriodicWork` with an `ExistingPeriodicWorkPolicy.KEEP` instead.
note: 前句:使用 enqueue() 排 PeriodicWorkRequest 可能無意間排入重複請求。

note: 『被系統強制改成 15 分鐘』頁面未逐字寫,核心下限主張成立。

note: 原文接 androidx.startup.InitializationProvider needs to be removed from the AndroidManifest.xml file。注意新版 lint 說的是移除 InitializationProvider(或其下 WorkManagerInitializer 節點),型錄寫的 meta-data 名稱屬舊/細部寫法,建議核對;主張方向一致。

quote: When you define a ListenableWorker which is constructed using the default WorkerFactory,
note: 原文接 the ListenableWorker sub-type needs to be public。

note: lint 頁:使用 setForegroundAsync() 時必須覆寫 SystemForegroundService 條目並宣告前景服務類型。MissingForegroundServiceTypeException 例外名稱頁面未逐字出現,但主張一致。

quote: Failing to implement the corresponding `getForegroundInfo` method can lead to runtime crashes when calling `setExpedited` on older platform versions.
note: 同頁:Any ListenableWorker must implement the getForegroundInfo method。

quote: You should wrap `setForeground()` in a `try/catch` block to catch a potential `IllegalStateException`.
note: 同句後:Android 12 以上可用更細的 ForegroundServiceStartNotAllowedException。

查了 ListenableWorker.Result 與 define-work 頁:只有 success/failure/retry 各自語意,沒有任何一段講『吞例外後回 success 是壞寫法』或資料默默遺失。屬由 Result 語意推得的推論,缺直接原文;detekt SwallowedException 頁也未查到與 Worker 連結。
